summary: Haoxi Health Technology Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting a private placement of 40,000,000 Class B ordinary shares at $0.018 per share ($720,000 aggregate) to CEO Zhen Fan on May 18, 2026. The price reflects a 101.12% premium to the closing price of Class A shares. The audit committee approved the related-party transaction as fair. The filing is a routine capital-raising disclosure with no special-situation catalyst; it is not an acquisition, tender offer, going-private, or other special situation.
